name: academic-deck
description: Build academic and training presentations (lectures, workshops, research talks, professional training) as editable .pptx files. Bundles the academic-training-deck skill — an 18-layout design system in two palettes (Warm Academic burgundy / Lean Corporate teal) with a ready pptxgenjs layout library, a template generator, and an automated QA checker — plus the /academic-deck command that turns a brief into a finished deck.
